prior_verdicts.py DEFECT, NEW AND MATERIAL -- it reports FALSE blocking verdicts, two distinct heads. (1) Single-letter tickers defeat the word-boundary matcher: ticker L matches \bL\b inside 'P&L' because & is a non-word character, so L (Loews) was flagged blocking off a passage about ROST that never mentions it. (2) The blocking keyword is scoped to the PASSAGE, not the ticker: blocking = any(b in s.lower() for b in BLOCKING), so any name appearing in a sentence that vetoes some OTHER name inherits a false block -- DBX was flagged off a passage that explicitly CLEARS DBX while vetoing AVB and BAH. This cost S4 five names tonight (ZION/DBX/AMRZ/GXO/INFY), of which only AMRZ (cross-lane contradiction) and INFY (stale, now moot) had any merit. Fix: require len(ticker)>=2 for free-text matching, and scope the keyword search to the ticker's own clause.
